title: 最小稳态导热板：解析解验证演示

provenance.status: New demonstrator, not the original research model. Builder only saves an unsolved MPH.

parameters.name: T_hot
parameters.source: README.md: fixed right temperature for the analytic verification case

geometry.description: 10 mm by 5 mm rectangle, origin (0,0); length expression L_geom=L. Coordinate Box selections left/right must select one distinct boundary each; domain selection plate must contain one domain.

materials.name: Homogeneous verification material
materials.properties: k=1 W/(m*K), rho=1000 kg/m^3, Cp=1000 J/(kg*K); constant isotropic properties.

couplings.description: Single Heat Transfer interface; no multiphysics coupling in this executor verification example.

boundary_conditions.condition: Default thermal insulation, no internal heat source

mesh.description: mesh1, FreeTri; custom maximum size L/12, minimum size L/120; built and saved before solving.

solver.description: std1 stationary study; sol1 generated by COMSOL 6.3 showAutoSequences(sol); builder does not run it.

assumptions: New independent verification example; it does not reproduce or validate the original multiphysics research model.
Steady 2D conduction, homogeneous isotropic constant material, no source, fixed left/right temperatures and insulated remaining boundaries.
Analytic solution T(x)=293.15 K + 10 K*x/L, so the domain mean is 298.15 K.
Only T_hot is a physics-scalar override; L affects both geometry indirectly through L_geom and the mesh directly.
acceptance: Require a nonempty new solution, case_no=1, finite mean temperature within [298.149,298.151] K.
Record actual elapsed solve time; a target under 300 seconds is not a pre-measured guarantee.
Keep launcher/batch logs, approval receipt, metrics CSV and output MPH; later field/table export must use the solved dataset.
